# Timeline of 2013

A chronological index of the articles in this knowledge base. Dates are the
single ISO date each topic is primarily associated with.

## March

- **2013-03-19** — [Malala Yousafzai's Education Advocacy & Malala Fund]({{ '/news/people/malala-yousafzai-education-advocate/' | relative_url }}) *(People)* — Malala returns to school in Birmingham and co-founds the Malala Fund, becoming the youngest-ever Nobel Peace Prize nominee that year.

## April

- **2013-04-15** — [Google Glass Explorer Program Launch]({{ '/news/science-technology/google-glass-launch/' | relative_url }}) *(Science & Technology)* — Google begins distributing prototype augmented-reality glasses to 8,000 "Explorers," pioneering mainstream wearable AR.

## June

- **2013-06-05** — [Edward Snowden's NSA Revelations]({{ '/news/history-politics/snowden-nsa-revelations/' | relative_url }}) *(History & Politics)* — Disclosure of classified NSA surveillance programs including PRISM, triggering a global debate over privacy and state power.

## November

- **2013-11-19** — ['Selfie' Named Oxford Dictionaries Word of the Year]({{ '/news/arts-culture/selfie-oxford-word-of-year/' | relative_url }}) *(Arts & Culture)* — Oxford Dictionaries crowns "selfie" its Word of the Year after a 17,000% surge in usage, marking the mainstreaming of digital self-documentation.
- **2013-11-29** — [Bitcoin's Dramatic Price Rise to $1,000]({{ '/news/society-economics/bitcoin-price-surge/' | relative_url }}) *(Society & Economics)* — Bitcoin briefly exceeds $1,200 per coin, its first major speculative boom to reach mainstream financial attention.
